description.content: Updates the bandwidth rate limit schedule for a specified gateway. By default, gateways do not have bandwidth rate limit schedules, which means no bandwidth rate limiting is in effect. Use this to initiate or update a gateway's bandwidth rate limit schedule. This operation is supported only for volume, tape and S3 file gateways. FSx file gateways do not support bandwidth rate limits.
